'''Hissyphus''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who raided the [[CI-004 Research Facility]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] in [[3627 BBY]]. He suffered mutations in the [[Evolutionary Warfare Laboratory]] and was [[CI-004 Incident|killed]] by a security team soon after.
